methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes source structure (toc_inventory.json / derived/scope_packets/PL.json), corrected against raw OCR of ~30 body pages (pdf 1312-1354) via PyMuPDF text extraction. PL's toc_inventory.json is structurally much cleaner than prior chapters (no two-column TOC corruption, no unresolved_headings.json entries, candidate_set_truncated: false) but contains one significant defect matching the project-flagged 'broad node containing multiple distinct clinical topics' / 'topics attached to the wrong section' risk pattern for this chapter: PL.S08 ('Craniofacial Injuries', recorded pdf range 1341-1350) silently absorbs six topics (T08 'Anatomy' through T13 'Breast Reconstruction') that raw OCR body-confirms are a wholly distinct 'Breast' section beginning with a 'Breast Anatomy' heading partway through pdf 1345 (TN page PL35), immediately after the real Craniofacial Injuries content (Approach to Facial Injuries through Traumatic Auricular Hematoma, T01-T07) ends. toc_inventory.json has no node at all for this Breast section header, matching the OR-chapter 'silently dropped section header' pattern; the six Breast topics are represented here as SU-PL-32 through SU-PL-37 under a synthetic UNCATALOGUED section (see each unit's structural_rationale for the shared correction note) rather than left folded into Craniofacial Injuries. A secondary, minor one-page section-boundary drift was also confirmed by body OCR: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome (PL.S06.T08) occupies the full body-visible page at pdf 1340 (not within PL.S06's packet-recorded 1334-1339 range), pushing Brachial Plexus (PL.S07) to begin at pdf 1341 rather than the packet-recorded 1340 -- both corrected in SU-PL-23/24. PL.S09's merged_duplicate_headings field ('Gender-Affirming Surgery') was independently body-confirmed via Table 36 on pdf 1352 and represented as SU-PL-39 under a synthetic UNCATALOGUED id, matching the OR-chapter body-recovered-heading precedent. No other section boundary, topic ordering, or parent-child relationship in toc_inventory.json's 61 PL nodes was found to conflict with body-page spot verification (~20 additional pages checked across S01-S07, S09-S11). Excluded as non-clinical organizational/reference material: the chapter root (PL) and PL.S11 (References).
